name: spg-v2: E4 at 5M steps with faster duals
question: Do aggregate_loose (x_h + x_v <= 2, fixed weights 1/d_i) and multi converge given 2.5x the steps of E4 and a faster multi dual?

code.commit: aggregate_loose runs: fe872d5; multi runs: b0441c0 (same Python code as ac53cc6, which removed the pi0 code; budget path verified bit-identical on toy runs)

dual_lr_reason: multi 0.04 matches the growth rate of the shared multiplier at 0.02 (E5a reasoning); aggregate_loose keeps E4's 0.02

evaluation.checkpoint_eval: 10 episodes, environment seed 10000+seed, every 25 updates, chunk 2 (differs from E4's chunk 10)
evaluation.final_eval: 50 episodes, environment seed 200000+seed, action seed 300000+seed, chunk 2

commands: nice -n 10 python run_pilot.py --group spg-v2-aggregate-loose --methods aggregate_loose --budget-hazard 31.9 --budget-vase 73.9 --transitions 5000000 --device cpu --max-parallel 3
nice -n 10 python run_pilot.py --group spg-v2-multi --methods multi --budget-hazard 31.9 --budget-vase 73.9 --transitions 5000000 --device cpu --max-parallel 3 --extra "--dual-lr 0.04"
runs/spg-v2.sh (the two launches, held-out evaluation, summarize_runs.py)
output: runs/spg-v2-aggregate-loose/, runs/spg-v2-multi/ on the lab machine tml (20 cores, 15 GB); W&B project multi-cost-rl, groups spg-v2-aggregate-loose / spg-v2-multi
notes: Interpretation A of the professor's suggestion (fixed weights, sum <= 2); interpretation B (violation-adaptive weights) is open for the next lab meeting (progress.md).
renamed: run directories renamed from sg-pilot-v2-loose / sg-pilot-v2-multi on 2026-10-24 after training; each run's config.json and manifest.json keep the old group name
